# Task P0-05: Structured logging with secret redaction

**Phase:** 0 · **Depends on:** P0-02 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
Serilog writes one JSON object per line to the console and to rolling files under `<config dir>/logs`, logs each HTTP request once, and **never** lets a secret (the API key, passwords, tokens) reach any sink.

## Deliverables
In `src/Compilarr.Core/Logging/` (namespace `Compilarr.Core.Logging`; Serilog is allowed in Core):
- `LogOptions` (section `Log`): `string Level = "Information"` (Serilog level name; validated, message starts with `log.level:`), `LogConsoleFormat ConsoleFormat = Json` (enum `Json | Text`), `int RetainedFiles = 7` (1–100), `int FileSizeLimitMb = 10` (1–1000). YAML keys `level`, `console_format`, `retained_files`, `file_size_limit_mb`. Register with `AddOptions<LogOptions>().Bind(...).ValidateOnStart()` in `AddCompilarrConfiguration`.
- `CleanseLogMessage` ← port of `.worker/ref/Lidarr/src/NzbDrone.Common/Instrumentation/CleanseLogMessage.cs` (GPL-3.0; header `// Ported from Lidarr (https://github.com/Lidarr/Lidarr), src/NzbDrone.Common/Instrumentation/CleanseLogMessage.cs, GPL-3.0.` plus an adaptation line). Keep the URL/query, `username/password=`, JSON `"password"/"api_key"` style, Plex token and path-username rules; drop tracker-specific ones (torrentleech, iptorrents, hd.me, avistaz, BroadcastheNet, Notifiarr). Add rules for the header forms `X-Api-Key: <v>` and `Authorization: Bearer <v>`. Replacement text is `(removed)`, as in Lidarr.
- `ISecretRegistry` / `SecretRegistry` (singleton): `void Register(string? secret)` (ignores null/empty and values shorter than 6 chars), and `string Redact(string text)` that replaces every registered secret (ordinal) with `(removed)` and then applies `CleanseLogMessage`. At startup register `ServerOptions.ApiKey` (and re-register on `IOptionsMonitor` change). Later tasks register Soulseek/Plex secrets the same way.
- `RedactingTextFormatter : ITextFormatter` — formats with the inner formatter into a buffer, then writes `registry.Redact(buffer)`. Both sinks use it, so message text, properties and exceptions are all covered.
- JSON line format via `Serilog.Expressions` `ExpressionTemplate`: `{ {timestamp: @t, level: @l, message: @m, exception: @x, props: rest()} }` + newline (property names exactly `timestamp`, `level`, `message`, `exception`, `props`). Text console format: `[{@t:HH:mm:ss} {@l:u3}] {SourceContext}: {@m}\n{@x}`.
- `LoggingSetup.Configure(LoggerConfiguration cfg, LogOptions options, CompilarrPaths paths, ISecretRegistry registry)` — minimum level from options, `Microsoft.AspNetCore` overridden to `Warning`, `FromLogContext`, console sink, file sink `Path.Combine(paths.LogsDir, "compilarr-.json")` with `RollingInterval.Day`, `rollOnFileSizeLimit: true`, `fileSizeLimitBytes`, `retainedFileCountLimit`, `shared: true`.

In `src/Compilarr.Api/Program.cs`: `builder.Host.UseSerilog((ctx, services, cfg) => LoggingSetup.Configure(...))` using the registry from DI; `app.UseSerilogRequestLogging()` placed right after `UseForwardedHeaders` (or first, if P0-04 has not landed), with the request path logged **without** its query string.

## Allowed paths
- `src/Compilarr.Core/Logging/**`, `src/Compilarr.Core/Configuration/**` (only to register `LogOptions`), `src/Compilarr.Core/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Core/Compilarr.Core.csproj`
- `src/Compilarr.Api/Program.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Compilarr.Api.csproj`
- `Directory.Packages.props` (add only the packages below)
- `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Logging/**`, `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/**`, `tests/fixtures/logging/**`
- Read-only: `.worker/ref/Lidarr/**`

## Context to read first
- `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md` (Logging)
- `.worker/ref/Lidarr/src/NzbDrone.Common/Instrumentation/CleanseLogMessage.cs`
- `src/Compilarr.Core/Configuration/*.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Program.cs`

## Constraints
- Package versions (already resolved; do not look them up): `Serilog.Expressions` 5.0.0, `Serilog.Sinks.Console` 6.1.1 if not pulled in by `Serilog.AspNetCore` 10.0.0 (check `dotnet list package --include-transitive` before adding it). `Serilog.AspNetCore` 10.0.0 and `Serilog.Sinks.File` 7.0.0 are already in `Directory.Packages.props`; move the `Serilog.*` references Core needs into `Compilarr.Core.csproj`.
- Tests write logs into a per-test temp dir and dispose the logger before reading files. Never mutate process environment variables.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated by tests)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings; `dotnet test` → all pass.
2. A logger built by `LoggingSetup.Configure` writing to a temp dir produces a file `logs/compilarr-<date>.json` whose lines parse as JSON objects with `timestamp`, `level`, `message` and `props`.
3. With API key `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef` registered: logging `"Calling http://x/api?apikey={Key}"` with the key as a property, an exception whose message contains the key, and the plain text `X-Api-Key: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef` — the file contains none of those key characters and contains `(removed)`.
4. `CleanseLogMessage` golden cases in `tests/fixtures/logging/cleanse.json` (`{ "cases": [ { "input": "...", "expected": "..." } ] }`, at least 10 cases incl. `password=hunter2`, `?X-Plex-Token=abc123`, `"api_key":"abc"`, `Authorization: Bearer abc.def`, and one string that must stay unchanged) run through a data-driven test.
5. An API request `GET /ping?apikey=<key>` produces one request log event whose rendered output contains `/ping` and not the key.

## Out of scope
- A log viewer endpoint or UI (Phase 5); slskd log capture (P0-09); per-category level settings.
